description_for_human: Model Context Protocol (MCP) manifest for the Chi311 automation server.
description_for_model: Provides search/fetch tools and an automation submit endpoint for Chicago 311 service requests, plus an SSE stream for events.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search available Chicago 311 request types and automation handlers.

query.description: Natural language query to search available request types or handlers.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full schema or module source for a search result id.

id.description: The id returned by search (module id or form request id).

tools.name: submit_311_request
tools.description: Trigger the automation orchestration to fill (and optionally submit) a Chicago 311 request.

request_type.description: Request type id from the form schema catalog.

fields.description: Optional mapping of exact field labels to values to override automatic mapping.

contact.description: Optional contact info (first_name, last_name, email, phone).

tools.name: sse
tools.description: Server-Sent Events endpoint clients can open to receive asynchronous events from the MCP server.

notes: This manifest is a static MCP manifest. If you want dynamic values (e.g., public base_url), either generate this file at runtime or ensure it is updated with the correct public URL after deployment. The endpoints are relative to the server root.
